The '''Imperial Intelligence Operations Center''' was an installation run by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coronar]]. After being repaired at the [[Tolan Navy Yards]], the [[Imperial Armored Transport]] [[Elusive (transport)|''Elusive'']] set its course for the intelligence center to turn in valuable information recovered from the wreckage of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Dankayo Base]].<ref name="SH" />
